title: Fly-By-Wire
subtitle: I Made a Fly Drive a Car
executive_one_liner: We took a proofread Drosophila connectome (FlyWire), traced geometry through the graph (3D neuron positions → 30×30 retinotopic grid), and run live control as pure weighted geometric projection — brightness at mapped coordinates × synapse counts — with ~1,555 FLOPs/frame and no neural network training at inference time.

thesis.headline: geometry is the precursor to intelligence
claims: Structure + placement + weights from anatomy, not learned embeddings
The hard part was finding the right coordinates in connectome space — not training

compute.notes: Excludes CARLA rendering, camera ingest, looming controller, and Python overhead

phases.name: Entering the Connectome (FlyWire / CAVE)
phases.private_regen: Full connectome export and calibration pipeline are not shipped

phases.name: Topology Tracing: Who Drives Steering?
phases.description: Graph-geometry discovery: walk upstream in synapse space from descending motor neurons to visual and motion layers.

steps.name: Anchor on descending steering neurons
steps.detail: Start from DNx02 cell type in hierarchical_neuron_annotations → pt_root_id list

steps.name: Walk upstream in synapse space
steps.detail: strong_upstream(post_ids) = pres with synapse count > threshold onto those posts

steps.name: Layered hops
layers: Motion layer — T4/T5-like population (threshold > 3), referred to as motion GPU

steps.name: Fetch 3D geometry
steps.detail: Query proofread_neurons for pt_position (x, y, z) of motion-layer IDs
steps.presentation_point: Intelligence here is literally where neurons sit in space, not a latent vector learned offline

phases.name: Retinotopy: 3D Connectome → 30×30 Fly Eye Grid
pipeline: Min-max normalize x,y from connectome coordinates → [0, 1]

artifacts.note: Only retinotopy map shipped; early lineage files are regen-only

phases.presentation_point: Each neuron sees one pixel of a downsampled world — geometry binds vision to circuit

phases.name: Synaptic Weight Matrix Export
phases.export_logic: For all discovered brain IDs, pull (pre, post, n_syn, NT scores) and collapse NT argmax → nt_type

artifacts.role: Production weights loaded by CARLA pilot (only model CSV shipped)
Provenance and calibration story for shipped circuit

weight_semantics.synapse_count: Connection strength from anatomy, not learned
weight_semantics.interpretation: Sparse geometric inner product from retina to motor command neurons

phases.name: Steering Pair Selection
phases.description: Geometry validated on training video, not backprop policy learning

discovery.method: Enumerate DNx02 pairs; score differential push on straight-road calibration footage; pick strongest pair

validation.pipeline: Video → gray → 30×30 INTER_AREA → right_push, left_push, steering bias
validation.note: Uses shipped production weights + grid; calibration footage is local-only

phases.name: Calibration as Geometric Surgery
phases.description: Structural edits on the connectome graph, not gradient descent training
steps: Prune synapses into LEFT while straight-driving pixels are active
Mirror grid_x and duplicate LEFT pathway to RIGHT for binocular symmetry
Boost synapses into the command layer for usable drive
Apply tiny left-side gain to zero straight-road bias → fly_pilot_production_v1.csv
phases.private_regen: Calibration step scripts and footage are not shipped
phases.honest_caveat: Engineered calibration (R0 offset, gain, mirror duplication). Still geometry-first, but not pure connectome-as-is.

throttle.targets: DNg01/02 subtypes (regex DNg0[12].*, 35 neurons, 30581 synapses export)

slides.title: Thesis
slides.content: Intelligence = geometry of connections + geometry of positions. No transformer. No RL at inference. Anatomy is the model.

slides.title: Data
slides.content: FlyWire proofread connectome → v783 materialization → synapse tables with NT context

slides.title: Graph Walk
slides.content: DNx02 → supervisors → visual → motion (T4/T5 layer). Show hops as nodes/edges.

slides.title: Retinotopic Projection
slides.content: 3D (x,y,z) → normalized → 30×30 grid. One slide with grid overlay concept.

slides.title: Steering Discovery
slides.content: Steering pair search on straight/left videos; fixed RIGHT/LEFT IDs.

slides.title: Calibration as Geometry Edits
slides.content: Mirror eye, gain injection, symmetry factor — not gradient descent.

slides.title: Longitudinal Expansion
slides.content: DNg03 brake + DNg01/02 throttle from separate connectome exports.

slides.title: Live Demo
slides.content: CARLA: connectome steering + optional pure-neural longitudinal modes. Use demos/ launchers.

slides.title: Honest Boundaries
slides.content: Sparse steer fan-in; engineered calibration; partial eye-map overlap; core behavior still from connectome geometry.

punchlines_for_execs: We imported a real brain graph and drove a car with it.
Inference is a geometric dot product, not a billion-parameter model.
The hard part was finding the right coordinates in connectome space — not training.
demo_talking_points: Point to logs: r_push, l_push, steer, b_drive, t_drive
Show mode flags: pure neural vs fused
Wall test: distinguish physics collision stop (brake=0) vs controller stop (b_neuron>0 or b_loom>0)
Mention FLOPs vs CARLA rendering cost (model is negligible)

recording.camera: Chase camera attached behind vehicle (matches spectator-style view)
